newsitem.title: USA: Wash. Water Power to extend Idaho rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Wash. Water Power to extend Idaho rate cut.

text.p: Washington Water Power Co said Monday it filed with Idaho regulators to extend a 2.344 percent power rate rebate through August 31, 1998.
The rebate is due to expire at the end of August.

The rate mechanism, put in place by the Idaho Public Utilities Commission, was implemented to primarily reflect changes in the company's power supply costs associated with abnormal streamflows, which affect hydroelectric power generation.

"The mechanism was designed to deal with both favorable and unfavorable power supply conditions. Since its inception in October 1989, there have been five rebates and three surcharges, including the rebate extension we are currently proposing," said Ron McKenzie, senior rate accountant for Washington Water Power.
